author: Iloxy
quote: I don't want to have to obey an abusive girlfriend against my will. They should rename the game “Grand Simp Simulator” instead of “Grand Theft Auto.” You shouldn't have let your “woke” campaigns seep into GTA. Having to do a ton of things in the game to make our “girlfriend” happy should never be a central plot point in GTA. Why do I have to go do missions just to make her happy because she’s on her period? In which GTA game has this ever happened? Do whatever it takes to bring Dan Houser back, or this game will be the end of you.
